    1. handle(HttpRequest, E)

Interface AsyncErrorRouteHandler<E extends Throwable>

Type Parameters:
E - The type of the exception
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface AsyncErrorRouteHandler<E extends Throwable>
A handler function for an error that completes the response later: the asynchronous ErrorRouteHandler, like an @Error(global = true) method returning a CompletionStage. It handles the exceptions of controller routes and handler routes alike, including the exception a stage of an AsyncRequestHandler or an AsyncBodyRequestHandler completes with.

Like every error route it runs on the thread that handles the error, which can be the event loop, so it must not block. It receives the request, without the AsyncRequestBody of an asynchronous route: the error can occur after the route read the body, or while it was reading it, so the body is not offered to the error route to read again.

routes.errorAsync(QuotaExceededException.class, (request, error) -> quotas.retryAfter(request)
    .thenApply(retryAfter -> HttpResponse.status(HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS).header(HttpHeaders.RETRY_AFTER, retryAfter)));
